name: Text-to-Speech Voices
description: Google's Chirp 3 HD voices for tts.synthesize: name, gender and language, optionally for one language. Asked of Google at most once a day per language. provider="elevenlabs" uses the owner's ElevenLabs plan instead.
requires: GOOGLE_TTS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT in the vault (a Google Cloud service account key file)
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the vault, for provider="elevenlabs"
aliases: which voices can read my book
